title: CosyPose: Consistent multi-view multi-object 6D pose estimation
family: instance-level; render-based refinement; multi-view scene optimization
input: One/multiple RGB views + camera intrinsics; detections for single-object estimator
object_prior: Known metric 3D object models; relative camera poses may be unknown
training_requirement: Known-object detection/coarse/refiner training; multi-view matching and scene refinement
output: Object poses and relative camera poses in a consistent scene; single-view object-to-camera R,t
